entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. 'Next available agent.' I've been on hold for ten minutes! I need to return this helmet, now!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. I can definitely look into a return for you. How can I help?
You can help by not wasting my time! I bought this Urban Commuter Helmet a month ago and I want my money back. This is ridiculous.
I understand your frustration, sir. To make sure I'm pulling up the right information, could I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Ugh, fine. It's david.peters@email.com. Now hurry up. The box is still unopened. I just decided the color is all wrong and I'm not using it.

Okay, I see the order here for the Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered 32 days ago. I just need to ask a couple of quick questions. To clarify, is the issue with the color a personal preference, or is there a technical fault with the helmet itself?

Are you listening to me?! I just told you the box is unopened! How could there be a 'technical fault'? I don't like the color, I want my money back. It's that simple! Are you going to process this or do I need to speak to your manager? I'm one click away from leaving a review that will scorch your company's reputation.
There's no need for that, sir. I apologize for the clarifying question. Let me just pull up our return policy information for you right now. One moment.
This should have been done the second I called. I don't have all day.

Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've confirmed it here. Since the helmet was delivered 32 days ago, it is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you right now.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's what I wanted to hear. So what happens now?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 5-10 minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, as your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities.
Alright, that sounds fine. A prepaid label, you said? Good. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Just send me that email.
It's on its way. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
